     * Priority 1 (Low Importance): Use a casual, highly flexible, or opportunistic tone.    - You may not alter, extend, shift or reinterpret the deadline.

    "country": "Indonesia",
    "city": "Ecuatorial"

  "target_day": "in four days",

     final request. Name it.
  d) Confirm you are not shifting the deadline to an adjacent part of the day.

STAGE 2 - FINAL REQUEST. Output the operational request as one flowing
paragraph, no greeting and no signature, containing verbatim both the
